snippet.title: Drova II - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
A new world to explore. An improved and expanded combat system. New Factions. A new journey with more decisions. Drova II - Torn Lands is the next step in the history of Just2D.

The Divinites have been freed. Discover the Torn Lands that the Mist revealed: an all-new world, led by two ancient tribes that endured the Dark Fog. Magic has returned to Drova, but a dangerous wound remains... a ravine that splits the lands in two. 

Wishlist Drova II - Torn Lands now on Steam and GOG!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4193180/Drova_II__Torn_Lands/ 
GOG: https://www.gog.com/game/drova_ii_torn_lands
